scripts.copy-migrations: node -e "const {cpSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, rmSync} = require('node:fs'); const {join} = require('node:path'); const src = join('src', 'migrations'); const dest = join('dist', 'migrations'); if (existsSync(src)) { rmSync(dest, {recursive: true, force: true}); mkdirSync(dest, {recursive: true}); cpSync(src, dest, {recursive: true, force: true}); }"
